account.free.note: This money is yours and revocable: you can withdraw it at any time without giving a reason.
account.free.title: Free part
account.history.empty.body: The first record appears when your transfer arrives.
account.history.empty.title: No movements yet
account.history.title: Account movements
account.locked.empty: Nothing is locked right now: the whole balance is free.
account.locked.note: This money is yours too, but it is locked to specific deals and cannot fund another one: the deal it is locked to may roll back, and then the money must return.
account.locked.title: Locked part
account.locked.untilPaused: No date yet: the clock on this deal is paused
account.source.note: Refunds and withdrawals go only here and only in your name. The refund address cannot be changed — it is the account the money came from.
account.source.title: Source account
account.subtitle: One account for all your deals in both roles. The free part and the locked part are shown separately — only the free part can fund your next purchase.
account.title: My account
account.withdraw.locked.reason: There is no free balance right now: all of it is locked to deals. Withdrawal opens as soon as a reservation is released or a settlement is done.
account.withdraw.noSource: There is nowhere to withdraw to yet: the source account appears after the first incoming payment. A refund can only go there.
account.withdraw.note: Withdrawals go only to {account} at {bank} and only in your name. A withdrawal has no other address — that is a safeguard, not a restriction.
account.withdraw.partial: You can withdraw the free part. The locked part becomes available when the deals below close.
assurance.ladder.heading: How solid your position is
assurance.ladder.note: You are at level {level} of {total}. This is not a payment guarantee: it describes where the money is and what can happen to it.
assurance.limits: What we do not promise: that the money cannot be recalled, that registration will happen, or that the deadline will be extended. We are responsible for one thing — while the reservation holds, the money goes neither to a third party nor to us.
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.body: The reservation is released automatically and the money stays with the payer.
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.retry: The deal can be run again: the checks of the parties and the property are kept.
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.title: Registration not confirmed in time
assurance.outcomes.registered.body: The settlement runs the same business day and the money goes to your account.
assurance.outcomes.registered.title: Registration confirmed
assurance.outcomes.title: What happens in each of the two outcomes
assurance.state.frozen.subtitle: The money is where it was and is not moving. A check is under way; we will write as soon as it is over.
assurance.state.frozen.title: Operations on this deal are paused
assurance.state.heldThirdParty.subtitle: The payment came from another person and is held pending review.
assurance.state.heldThirdParty.title: Funds are not deposited
assurance.state.notFunded.subtitle: The payer is verified, but there is no money in the deal yet. It is too early to file.
assurance.state.notFunded.title: Funds are not deposited yet
assurance.state.onAccount.subtitle: The amount is on their account, but it remains their property and is revocable. The reservation is placed on filing day — filing before that is premature.
assurance.state.onAccount.title: The money is with the payer, not reserved yet
assurance.state.onAccountFx.subtitle: The money is on the payer account in another currency. There is no reservation yet.
assurance.state.onAccountFx.title: Funds deposited but not converted
assurance.state.overfunded.subtitle: The payer sent more than needed; the excess is not part of the deal.
assurance.state.overfunded.title: The amount is collected
assurance.state.partiallyFunded.subtitle: The payer has not sent everything. The top-up deadline and its consequence are below.
assurance.state.partiallyFunded.title: Part of the amount is collected
assurance.state.payoutUnknown.subtitle: We do not resend it: that is the protection against a double payout. We will check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
assurance.state.payoutUnknown.title: The instruction was sent, the bank has not confirmed
assurance.state.refundInProgress.subtitl: The money is being returned to the payer bank account.
assurance.state.refundInProgress.title: The deal did not go through
assurance.state.refunded.subtitle: The money is back with the payer.
assurance.state.refunded.title: The deal did not go through
assurance.state.releasePending.subtitle: The money reaches your account today.
assurance.state.releasePending.title: Registration confirmed, the settlement is being prepared
assurance.state.released.subtitle: The money has gone to your account. The settlement document is available below.
assurance.state.released.title: The settlement is done
assurance.state.releasedToAccount.subtit: The reservation was released and the money went back to the payer. Nothing done in the checks is lost: a repeat deal will not start from scratch.
assurance.state.releasedToAccount.title: The deal did not go through
assurance.state.reserved.subtitle: The amount is reserved for this deal and held on a nominal holding account.
assurance.state.reserved.title: Funds are confirmed
assurance.state.rollbackInProgress.subti: Registration was not confirmed in time. The money goes back to the payer; the deal can be run again.
assurance.state.rollbackInProgress.title: The condition did not occur, the reservation is being released
assurance.state.submitted.subtitle: The reservation holds; we are waiting for the registry to confirm.
assurance.state.submitted.title: Funds confirmed, documents filed
assurance.state.transferDeclared.subtitl: The payer says it was sent; the bank has not confirmed the credit yet.
assurance.state.transferDeclared.title: Transfer declared, not confirmed
assurance.state.unidentified.subtitle: A payment arrived but was not identified and is not credited to the deal.
assurance.state.unidentified.title: Funds are not deposited
assurance.whereMoney.body: On a nominal holding account at {bank}. Not on our balance sheet and not at the payer disposal: they cannot move this money on their own.
assurance.whereMoney.revocable: We do not claim the payer cannot take the money back: until settlement the funds remain their property and are revocable, and the reservation window is short. Promising irrevocability would be untrue, so we promise something else: while the reservation holds, the money goes nowhere except to you or back to them.
assurance.whereMoney.title: Where the money is
assurance.youReceive.title: What you receive
banner.cooling.body: The settlement is paused for a cooling-off period. This is a safeguard: changing payout details right before settlement is the most common way money is stolen.
banner.cooling.title: The recipient is changing payout details
banner.coverage.body: Deals in progress are unaffected. Your funds are where they were and are not frozen.
banner.coverage.title: New deals are temporarily paused
banner.partial.body: The money state, the required action and the deadline are correct. One block failed to load and can be refreshed on its own.
banner.partial.title: Some data did not load
banner.quote.body: Lari amounts are being recalculated. You will see the new amount before you confirm anything, and nothing you entered is lost.
banner.quote.title: The rate lock has expired
deadline.consequence.refund: By then the money returns to your account with us. You can withdraw it to your bank right after that.
deadline.consequence.registration: If registration is not confirmed by then, the reservation is released automatically, the money stays with the payer, and the deal can be run again.
deadline.consequence.reserve: If the funds are not reserved by then, the money stays on your account and you can take it back.
deadline.consequence.review: By then we must finish the review. If we do not, the payment goes back to the sender.
deadline.consequence.settlement: By then the bank must confirm the transfer. Without confirmation we check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
deadline.consequence.topup: If the money does not arrive by then, the deal will not start and your funds stay with you.
deadline.heading: Deadline
deadline.none: There is no deadline yet: it appears once payment instructions are issued.
deadline.paused.compliance: Operations on this deal are paused for a check. Meanwhile the money does not move.
deadline.paused.registry: The registry is unavailable, so the deal clock is paused. Both sides see the same thing.
deadline.paused.remaining: When the clock stopped, {value} remained. We will name the new deadline once it resumes.
deadline.paused.title: The clock is paused
deal.action.heading: What is required from you now
deal.denied.body: The parties have changed. Your own movements on this deal are still visible under “My account”; write to us for anything else.
deal.denied.title: You no longer have access to this deal
deal.docs.watermarkNotice: Every document view is logged, and the document itself carries your identifier and the time you opened it.
deal.error.title: We could not show the state of this deal
deal.money.feeBreakdown.body: The settlement fee and the conversion spread are two different things. The fee is charged once on the deal amount. The spread appears only if the money arrived in another currency, and it is not returned on rollback: the conversion has already happened.
deal.money.heading: Money
deal.money.quoteExpired: The rate lock window has expired, so we do not show lari amounts right now: showing a stale amount is worse than showing none. You will see the new one before you confirm anything.
deal.money.rollbackNote: The settlement fee is not charged: there was no settlement. If the money arrived in another currency and was already converted, the conversion spread is not returned — the conversion did happen.
deal.parties.heading: Parties and documents
deal.paying.action.confirmRate.title: Confirm the rate and the lari amount
deal.paying.action.done: Nothing. The deal is closed, the documents are available
deal.paying.action.mismatch.reason: Funding is unavailable until the contract and the registry agree. This protects you: you should not pay for a property with the wrong area or the wrong owner.
deal.paying.action.mismatch.title: Nothing: we are resolving a discrepancy about the property
deal.paying.action.proveTransfer.title: Send us the proof of transfer
deal.paying.action.released.title: Choose what happens next: both paths are equal
deal.paying.action.requote.title: Confirm the new lari amount
deal.paying.action.support.title: Contact support: the deal is paused
deal.paying.action.thirdParty.title: Resolve the third-party payment
deal.paying.action.topup.title: Fund your account with the deal amount
deal.paying.action.topupRest.title: Send the remaining {amount}
deal.paying.action.waiting.bank: Nothing. We are waiting for the bank to credit the transfer — usually one business day
deal.paying.action.waiting.bankRefund: Nothing. The refund is in transit, waiting to be credited by your bank
deal.paying.action.waiting.filing: Nothing. We are waiting for the recipient to file the documents
deal.paying.action.waiting.payerFunds: Nothing. We are waiting for the payer to deposit the funds
deal.paying.action.waiting.reconciliatio: Nothing. We are waiting for the bank and will check the next business day statement
deal.paying.action.waiting.registry: Nothing. We are waiting for the registry to confirm the registration
deal.paying.action.waiting.reserve: Nothing. We are waiting for the filing day to place the reservation
deal.paying.action.waiting.restart: Nothing. The payer is deciding whether to withdraw or to run the deal again
deal.paying.action.waiting.rollback: Nothing. The reservation is being released and the money is going back to the payer
deal.paying.where.frozen.body: The money is where it was and is not moving. A check is under way; the deadline and the case number are below. This state has no automatic exit: a person decides.
deal.paying.where.frozen.title: Operations on this deal are paused
deal.paying.where.heldThirdParty.body: It came from another person and was stopped — including a spouse, a parent or your own company, unless agreed in advance. The money is safe: we either credit it after the review or return it to the sender.
deal.paying.where.heldThirdParty.title: The payment is held: the sender is not you
deal.paying.where.notFunded.body: Until the transfer arrives nothing happens in the deal: no reservation, no filing.
deal.paying.where.notFunded.title: The money has not arrived yet
deal.paying.where.onAccount.body: The reservation is placed on the day documents are filed. Until then the money stays yours and you can withdraw it without giving a reason.
deal.paying.where.onAccount.title: On your account. You can take it back at any time
deal.paying.where.onAccountFx.body: The money is yours and revocable. To move on, confirm the rate and the resulting lari amount — we convert nothing before you confirm.
deal.paying.where.onAccountFx.title: On your account, in the currency you sent
deal.paying.where.overfunded.body: Exactly the deal amount goes into the deal. The excess stays free on your account: it is not locked and you can withdraw it at any time.
deal.paying.where.overfunded.title: Your account holds more than the deal needs
deal.paying.where.partiallyFunded.body: Send the difference before the deadline below. If it is not collected, the deal will not start and what you sent stays on your account, ready to be withdrawn.
deal.paying.where.partiallyFunded.title: Your account holds less than the deal needs
deal.paying.where.payoutUnknown.body: We do not resend the instruction — that is the only way not to pay twice. We will check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
deal.paying.where.payoutUnknown.title: The instruction was sent, the bank has not confirmed yet
deal.paying.where.refundInProgress.body: Only to the source account and only in your name — a refund has no other address. Crediting usually takes one business day.
deal.paying.where.refundInProgress.title: The refund to your bank has been sent
deal.paying.where.refunded.body: The refund has been credited to the source account. The refund document is available with the deal documents.
deal.paying.where.refunded.title: The money is back in your bank
deal.paying.where.releasePending.body: The registry has confirmed the transfer of title. The settlement runs today; nothing is required from you.
deal.paying.where.releasePending.title: Registration confirmed, the settlement is running
deal.paying.where.released.body: The money is with the recipient and the deal is closed. Its documents stay available in this section.
deal.paying.where.released.title: The settlement is done
deal.paying.where.releasedToAccount.body: The money is yours and revocable again. Two equal paths from here: withdraw it to the source account or run the deal again.
deal.paying.where.releasedToAccount.titl: Back on your account: the deal did not go through
deal.paying.where.reserved.body: The money sits on a nominal holding account at {bank}: not with the recipient and not on our balance sheet. You cannot take it back until the window closes — and that is exactly what the other side sees.
deal.paying.where.reserved.title: Reserved for this deal
deal.paying.where.rollbackInProgress.bod: The money returns to your account with us, not to your bank: from there you can withdraw it or run the deal again. Nobody is at fault — the condition simply did not occur.
deal.paying.where.rollbackInProgress.tit: Registration was not confirmed in time, the reservation is being released
deal.paying.where.submitted.body: We are waiting for the registry to confirm the transfer. The reservation holds until the deadline below; nothing is required from you now.
deal.paying.where.submitted.title: Reserved, documents filed
deal.paying.where.transferDeclared.body: Crediting usually takes one business day. We will write as soon as the money lands — you do not need to watch it.
deal.paying.where.transferDeclared.title: Transfer sent, waiting for it to arrive
deal.paying.where.unidentified.body: It came without a recognised reference, so it is not credited to the deal and does not count as your balance. We are sorting it out by hand, usually within one business day.
deal.paying.where.unidentified.title: A payment arrived but was not identified
deal.property.heading: Property
deal.property.mismatch.title: The contract and the registry disagree
deal.property.mismatch.whatNow: Funding is unavailable until the discrepancy is resolved. We have requested an updated extract and will write as soon as the registry answers.
deal.receiving.action.done: Nothing. The deal is closed, the documents are available
deal.receiving.action.mismatch.reason: Funding is unavailable until the contract and the registry agree. This protects you: you should not pay for a property with the wrong area or the wrong owner.
deal.receiving.action.mismatch.title: Nothing: we are resolving a discrepancy about the property
deal.receiving.action.support.title: Contact support: the deal is paused
deal.receiving.action.waiting.bank: Nothing. We are waiting for the bank to credit the transfer — usually one business day
deal.receiving.action.waiting.bankRefund: Nothing. The refund is in transit, waiting to be credited by your bank
deal.receiving.action.waiting.filing: Nothing. We are waiting for the recipient to file the documents
deal.receiving.action.waiting.payerFunds: Nothing. We are waiting for the payer to deposit the funds
deal.receiving.action.waiting.reconcilia: Nothing. We are waiting for the bank and will check the next business day statement
deal.receiving.action.waiting.registry: Nothing. We are waiting for the registry to confirm the registration
deal.receiving.action.waiting.reserve: Nothing. We are waiting for the filing day to place the reservation
deal.receiving.action.waiting.restart: Nothing. The payer is deciding whether to withdraw or to run the deal again
deal.receiving.action.waiting.rollback: Nothing. The reservation is being released and the money is going back to the payer
deal.receiving.timeline.filed: You filed the documents for registration
deal.receiving.timeline.funds: The payer has deposited the funds
deal.receiving.timeline.moneyBack: The money went back to the payer
deal.timeline.clockPaused: The deal clock is paused: the registry is unavailable. All deadlines will be recalculated as soon as it responds.
deal.timeline.heading: How the deal is going
deal.timeline.unavailable: We could not load the deal timeline. The rest of the screen works and your money is untouched.
deals.empty.body: A deal is opened by an operator once the parties and the property are checked. Meanwhile you can pass identity verification — it is done once and covers every future deal in any role.
deals.empty.title: No deals yet
deals.error.title: We could not show your deals
deals.noDeadline: No deadline: the deal is closed
deals.state.onAccount.receiving: Money with the payer, not reserved yet
deals.state.payoutUnknown.receiving: Instruction sent, waiting for the bank
deals.state.refundInProgress.receiving: The deal did not go through
deals.state.refunded.receiving: The deal did not go through
deals.state.releasedToAccount.receiving: The deal did not go through
deals.subtitle: {name}, this is every deal of yours — the ones you pay for and the ones you are paid for. The role is written on each.
deals.title: My deals
error.moneySafe: Your money is untouched: this failure is about showing the page, not about your funds.
ops.breach.body: New deals are stopped automatically. This review comes first; everything else waits.
ops.breach.title: Client funds coverage is breached
ops.coverage.note: Balances on the accounts divided by liabilities to clients. The target is strictly one; any deviation stops new deals automatically.
ops.coverage.title: Client funds coverage
ops.empty.body: This is a good state, not a failure: everything that needed a person is done. The nearest deadline and the coverage are above.
ops.empty.title: The queue is empty
ops.emptyFilter.body: This is a filter result, not an empty queue. Reset the filter to see the other tasks.
ops.emptyFilter.title: Nothing matches the filter
ops.filter.label: Filter by task type
ops.mobileNote: On a phone the console shows only what is genuinely needed at night: payout approval and the duty metrics.
ops.mobileStub: This task opens on a desktop: the review needs documents and a second check. On a phone only payout approval and the duty metrics are available — enough to decide at night.
ops.subtitle: This is a work queue, not a list of deals. The system computes the priority: deadline first, then amount. There is nothing to configure.
ops.task.approve.note: There is no “pay out” button: execution starts when enough approvals from different accounts are collected.
ops.task.blocked.samePreparer: Approval is impossible for whoever prepared the operation or changed the payout details on this deal.
ops.task.claimedBy: Task claimed by {operator}. Two people do not work one task: that is the protection against a double decision.
ops.title: What needs me now
requisites.change.blocked.P-01: There are no details yet: add them first.
requisites.change.blocked.P-03: You need an account in your own name first. While the holder differs, saving is impossible.
requisites.change.blocked.P-04: Confirm the code from the test transfer first.
requisites.change.blocked.P-07: Funds are reserved for deal {deal}. You may request a change, but the payout will be paused for the cooling-off period.
requisites.change.blocked.P-09: A cooling-off period from the previous change is running. A second change is not accepted until it ends.
requisites.change.blocked.P-10: Less than 72 hours to settlement. The change is blocked automatically and a case has been opened.
requisites.history.confirm.code: Confirmed with the code from the test transfer
requisites.holderName.why: The name comes from your identity check and cannot be edited: the account must be in your name, and we do not allow even an attempt to enter someone else.
requisites.notMe.body: Press it and the request is cancelled at once, restoring the previous details. We also open an incident and hold the payout until it is reviewed.
requisites.notMe.title: Did someone else request this?
requisites.state.P-01.body: Without payout details there can be no payout. The holder name is taken from your identity check — you neither need nor can enter it.
requisites.state.P-01.title: No details yet
requisites.state.P-03.body: This is a hard stop, not a warning: a payout can only go to an account whose holder matches your identity check. There is no “save anyway” button. If the account really is yours, write to us and we will review it by hand.
requisites.state.P-03.title: The account is not in your name
requisites.state.P-04.body: We sent a small amount with a code in the reference. Enter the code — it confirms both the account and its holder. Attempts left: {attempts}.
requisites.state.P-04.title: A test transfer has been sent
requisites.state.P-06.body: The account is confirmed by the test transfer and the holder matches your identity check. You may change them, but a change starts a cooling-off period and pauses the payout.
requisites.state.P-06.title: Details are verified
requisites.state.P-07.body: Funds are reserved for deal {deal}, so the details are read-only. A change is possible, but it triggers re-verification, a cooling-off period and a notice to all parties, and the payout is barred for that time.
requisites.state.P-07.title: Details are locked by a reservation
requisites.state.P-09.body: The change was accepted but does not take effect immediately. While it runs, the payout is barred and all parties have been notified on every channel.
requisites.state.P-09.title: Cooling-off period is running
requisites.state.P-10.body: The form will not open: changing payout details in the last three days before settlement is impossible. A case has already been opened automatically; its number is in your correspondence.
requisites.state.P-10.title: Less than 72 hours to settlement: changes are blocked
requisites.subtitle: This is a security perimeter, not a form. Swapped payout details are the most common way money is stolen in a deal, so everything here is slow, announced to both sides, and never instant.
requisites.test.howItWorks: We send a small amount to this account with a code in the payment reference. This verifies both the account and that it is yours.
requisites.test.step.find: Find it in your statement: less than one lari, the code is in the reference
requisites.test.title: Test transfer with a code
requisites.title: Payout details
security.page.subtitle: Swapped bank details are the most common way money is stolen in a property deal. Here is what protects you and how to reach us.
security.page.title: Security and help
security.report.body: Tell us who contacted you and how. We reply the same business day and pause the settlement if needed.
security.report.title: Report a suspicious contact
security.rule.channels: We never share bank details by phone, email or messenger.
security.rule.neverAskTransfer: We never ask you to send money to a different account.
security.rule.onlyHere: The only place where you see bank details is this screen.
security.title: What we never do
